current.text: He is a rookie from the 2026 draft class.
If he earns a role, he could make about 2.5 threes in 20 minutes and add little else.
His dynasty rookie rank stayed at 31 after Summer League.
In Summer League, 10 of his 14 shots were threes, and he shot 21%.
Minnesota's bench is thin, with little scoring punch and no ball handlers.
Minnesota has a two-game week in the matchup starting March 15, which falls inside our fantasy playoffs. Experts call it the worst playoff schedule.

durable.text: He is a pure volume three-point shooter. He takes a huge share of his shots from three.
Before the draft he made his threes at a high rate.
Besides threes, he adds little in other categories.
